headline: President Bush changed the 2003 order that set up the President's Council on Service and Civic Participation.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13285, which created the President's Council on Service and Civic Participation, an advisory group on volunteering and civic involvement. The title does not say which parts were changed. Without more detail, the exact changes to the council's rules, members, or duties cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members and staff of the President's Council on Service and Civic Participation
who_it_affects.how: The rules that govern how their council works were changed in ways not described in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 27, 2005; the exact effective date is not stated in the provided material.
